description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarEventSerializer class, responsible for serializing and deserializing CalendarAccountEvent objects to and from JSON strings within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for converting event objects to JSON format and parsing JSON data back into event objects, handling potential errors during JSON processing.

classes.name: CalendarEventSerializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing CalendarAccountEvent objects to JSON strings and deserializing JSON strings back into CalendarAccountEvent objects.

methods.name: serializeEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into a JSON string representation.

methods.name: deserializeEvent
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a CalendarAccountEvent object, handling potential parsing errors.
